problem.title: Transport Characterizations of Mass-Stationarity
problem.statement: For an invariant random measure $\xi$, is invariance of its distribution under invariant mass-preserving transport kernels characteristic of mass-stationarity?
problem.background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [New Perspectives in Stochastic Geometry (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2008/47, pp. 2655--2702](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2008/47)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The source explicitly labels the converse characterization of mass-stationarity as an open problem; later work records only partial solutions to the corresponding transport-kernel questions.

**Sources checked.**

- [OWR Report 47](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2008/47)
- [Stationary and mass-stationary random measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/1405.7566)
- [Characterization of mass-stationarity](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.spa.2015.07.006)
